zh.title: 说明
items: **Peer Agent 0.1.0-beta.3** 是 0.1.0 的第三版预发布，走 beta 更新通道。正式版仍是 **0.0.18**。
默认界面是机器人列表。每个已有项目对应一个机器人。
可以在 设置 → 通用 → 界面 切回经典界面。切换不删除会话、档案或记忆。
原来的会话在各机器人的档案 → 任务 → 历史对话。
更新日志页面可以在「正式版」和「预发布」之间切换。预发布条目会标成「预发布」。

zh.title: 新功能
items: 升级后默认进入机器人列表，不再需要打开开发者开关。
需要你时，对话里会出现批准、决策和计划批准卡片。同一件事在对话和任务现场只处理一次。
可以对正在做的任务插话：并入当前任务，或停止它。引用一条消息时，这个动作只作用于这条消息提到的任务。
可以按需查看复核结论和证据。
可以调整主动性，并在设定时间收到今日小结。安静时段里的主动消息会等到时段结束。
项目记忆会进入对话，也可以在记忆页查看。后台会整理记忆。同一原因连续失败三次时，机器人会改为问你。
任务卡住，或同一原因反复失败时，机器人会被唤醒。
快捷对话、截图、搜索、菜单栏和快捷键在机器人模式下指向机器人。搜索可以找机器人、消息、任务和记忆。
快捷键：⌘1 到 ⌘9 切换列表前 9 个机器人，⌘N 新建机器人，⌘⇧P 开关档案，⌘F 聚焦列表搜索，⌘K 打开四类搜索。搜索面板打开时，⌘1 到 ⌘9 仍跳到搜索结果。⌘⇧N 仍是快捷对话。

zh.title: 已知限制
items: 同一项目同时只有一个正在执行的任务。项目目标、多任务并行、远程查看，以及终端里的机器人，这一版还没有。
机器人自己不能写文件。
机器人模式下的快捷对话只发送文字。截图送给机器人的是一张缩略图。

zh.title: 降级说明
items: 切回经典界面不会删除机器人、会话或记忆。
可以重新安装 0.1.0-beta.2 或 0.0.18，原来的会话可以打开。
降回 0.1.0-beta.2 时，这一版写下的 schema 3 设置文件保持原样，不会被改写。beta.2 仍按 设置 → 开发者 里的开关决定是否显示机器人列表，那个开关的原值还在。
档案、记忆和机器人输入写在本机数据目录。0.0.18 会忽略这些新增文件。

zh.title: CLI（仅命令行）
items: CLI 与 Desktop 共用 0.1.0-beta.3。终端里的 `peer` 仍是现在的会话 Agent，还不会打开项目机器人。
压缩包矩阵仍是 macOS ARM64 与 Linux x64。请把 `peer` 和 `peer-credential-helper` 放在同一目录。

en.title: Notes
items: **Peer Agent 0.1.0-beta.3** is the third prerelease on the 0.1.0 line and uses the beta update channel. The stable release remains **0.0.18**.
The default screen is the bot list. Each existing project has one bot.
Settings → General → Interface switches back to the classic screen. Switching does not delete conversations, profiles, or memories.
Older conversations are under each bot's profile → Tasks → History.
The changelog page can switch between Stable and Pre-release. Pre-release entries are marked Pre-release.

en.title: What's New
items: After this upgrade the app opens on the bot list. The developer switch is no longer required.
When a bot needs you, the conversation shows approval, decision, and plan-approval cards. The same item is resolved once, whether you answer in the conversation or in the task scene.
You can interrupt a running task by folding the new instruction into it, or by stopping it. Quoting a message limits that action to the tasks the message cites.
Verification detail and evidence can be opened on demand.
Proactivity can be changed, and the daily digest arrives at the time you set. Messages the bot starts during quiet hours wait until quiet hours end.
Project memory enters the conversation and has its own page. A background pass organizes memory. The same cause failing three times makes the bot ask you instead of retrying.
A stalled task, or the same cause failing again, wakes the bot.
In bot mode, quick chat, screenshots, search, the menu bar, and shortcuts point at bots. Search covers bots, messages, tasks, and memory.

Shortcuts: Command-1 through Command-9 switch the first nine bots, Command-N creates a bot, Command-Shift-P toggles the profile, Command-F focuses list search, and Command-K opens the four-kind search. While the search panel is open, Command-1 through Command-9 still jump to search results. Command-Shift-N still opens quick chat.

en.title: Known limits
items: One project still runs one task at a time. Project objectives, parallel tasks, remote viewing, and a bot in the terminal are not in this prerelease.
The bot itself cannot write files.
Quick chat in bot mode sends text only. A screenshot is delivered as a thumbnail.

en.title: Downgrade
items: Switching back to the classic screen does not delete bots, conversations, or memories.
You can install 0.1.0-beta.2 or 0.0.18 again and open your existing conversations.

If you return to 0.1.0-beta.2, the schema 3 settings file written by this prerelease stays as it is. beta.2 still uses the Settings → Developer switch to show the bot list, and that switch keeps its previous value.
Profiles, memories, and bot inputs live in the local data directory. 0.0.18 ignores those added files.

en.title: CLI (command-line only)
items: The CLI shares version 0.1.0-beta.3 with Desktop. `peer` in the terminal is still the current conversation agent and does not open a project bot.
The archive matrix remains macOS ARM64 and Linux x64. Keep `peer` and `peer-credential-helper` in the same directory.
